title: Navigating Kolkata During Durga Puja
intro: During Puja week, road traffic is heavily regulated with arterial roads converted to pedestrian zones. Kolkata's 5 operational Metro lines (including the underwater Green Line tunnel and Airport Yellow Line) plus Eastern & South Eastern Suburban Railways are your fastest, most reliable transport options.

sections.title: Additional Public Transit Options
body: WBTC Special Puja Circular Buses, Ganges River Ferries, and Auto-rickshaw hubs.

The original Kolkata Metro runs from Noapara in the north to Kavi Subhash (New Garia) in the south, passing through the heart of the city. This is the most convenient way to travel between pandals in North, Central, and South Kolkata.
Operating Hours: 6:45 AM to 10:45 PM (Extended to 11:45 PM during Puja)
The newer East-West Metro connects Salt Lake Sector V (IT hub) to Esplanade in Central Kolkata, passing under the Hooghly river to Howrah. Excellent for visitors staying in Salt Lake or New Town.
